info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Clearing Reviews API
info.description: The Card Clearing Reviews API enables users to submit feedback regarding card clearing transactions within the banking payment system. This API is designed for financial institutions and payment processors seeking to gather insights on customer experiences related to card clearing services. By submitting reviews, users can contribute to enhancing service quality and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include customer service teams and analytics departments aiming to improve card payment processes.

post.summary: Submit a review for a card clearing process.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a review regarding the card clearing with the specified ID. Use this to provide feedback or to report any issues encountered during the card clearing process.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to submit a review for the specified card clearing operation (CARD-400045). Ensure to provide the necessary details formatted as per the schema specifications.
